And if you have a Bitcoin account, there's no way a Bitcoin wallet can be locked or freezed by the bank because there's no authority that controls that with Bitcoin making and 21 million Bitcoins will ever be produced. So the way it works, is that Bitcoins are produced in block every 10 minutes. So currently 12.5 Bitcoins are produced per block every 10 minutes. And how does this work is that every four years it is halved. Get started here – http://www.bitclub.network/sindri . . Email me ...

textual.context: Promotional context for Bitclub Network; the description provides an external URL and says to email the speaker, but the email address is truncated/not supplied in the record.
textual.potential_relevance: A millionaire outcome claim is linked to a requested action to get started via a specific Bitclub URL and contact method, requiring later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish what the linked page contained, whether anyone contacted the speaker, or any actual financial outcome.

textual.observation: The speaker says BitClub Network invites viewers to join after describing a vision to produce 10,000 millionaires.

evidence.quote: So the vision here is to produce 10,000 millionaires. So the vision is big and if you want to be a part of it, Big Club Network is inviting you to join.

textual.limitations: The source records do not establish the basis for the 10,000-millionaire vision, whether it was achieved, or the viewer's actual next steps.
